# Codeforces

> > Codeforces is a competitive programming platform founded by Mikhail Mirzayanov, hosting contests, problems, and a global community of programmers.

Codeforces is one of the world's leading competitive programming platforms, offering regular contests, algorithmic problem sets, and community features for programmers of all skill levels. The platform provides a space for competitive programming enthusiasts to practice, compete, and improve their problem-solving abilities.

## Key Topics

- competitive programming
- contests
- algorithmic problems
- user authentication
- group access
- user accounts
- registration
- login
- Mikhail Mirzayanov
- Codeforces community
